nodes.title: Measure sample
nodes.description: Pour water sample from the sample bottle into the graduated cylinder until the meniscus reaches 20 mL.

nodes.description: Record the 20 mL sample volume in the notebook.

feedback.retry: Review Record sample volume and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer sample
nodes.description: Pour 20 mL of sample from the graduated cylinder into the 250 mL beaker.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer sample and try again.

nodes.title: Precipitate calcium carbonate
nodes.description: Pour carbonate reagent from the reagent bottle into the beaker to form calcium carbonate precipitate.

feedback.retry: Review Precipitate calcium carbonate and try again.
